title: The Solar System
summary: The Sun, eight planets and their huge distances. A scale model you can walk, and India’s missions to the Moon, Mars and the Sun.

ib.note: Gravitation and orbits are formalised in MYP 4–5

objectives: I can name the planets in order and describe some features of each.
I can use a scale model to describe the sizes and distances in the Solar System.
I can describe the difference between stars, planets and moons.
misconceptions: The planets are close together, as in textbook pictures.
Stars and planets are the same thing.
